## 🚀 Feature Request

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the pain point or use case.

**Example**: "As a data modeler, I want to... so that I can..."

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as detailed as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? If so, describe them here.

## 📊 Use Case

Provide a concrete example of how this feature would be used:

**Input**: [Example specification or scenario]

**Expected Output**: [What the agent/system should produce]

## 🏗️ Implementation Ideas

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here:
- Which files would need to be modified?
- Would this require new reference files?
- Would this require changes to agent skills?

## 📈 Impact & Benefits

Why is this feature valuable?
- [ ] Improves user experience
- [ ] Increases automation
- [ ] Reduces errors
- [ ] Enhances performance
- [ ] Expands functionality
- [ ] Other: [Please specify]

## 🎨 Mockups or Examples

If applicable, add mockups, diagrams, or examples to illustrate your feature.

## 🔗 Related Issues

Are there any related issues or feature requests? Link them here.

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals (semantic model automation)
- [ ] I have provided a clear use case
- [ ] I have described the expected behavior
